row.name: Becton Dickinson and Company Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=31 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.34 tightness=0.85 base_volume_vs_leg=0.82 base_volume_vs_avg=0.97
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 31 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 0.9% vs its 20-SMA, 3.6% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 0 of 1 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The burst bar's range is only 51% of the prior 5-bar maximum (RE FAIL) and volume came in at 86% of the prior session and 83% of the 50-session average — well below the 1.5x catalyst-volume requirement triggered by the 31-session base (VOL FAIL with cv_required). The base itself is 31 sessions, outside Bonde's 3–20 window, and the chart shows a wide, choppy consolidation from late August through early October with multiple overlapping red and green bars spanning roughly 175–193, confirming the PARTIAL C. These three independent defects together make this a weak setup.
claude.key_risk: Two hard FAILs on RE and VOL with a catalyst-volume requirement unmet mean the burst lacks the expansion and conviction needed for follow-through.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the signal day's close of 182.75 or if volume in the first 30 minutes is tracking below average, confirming the lack of conviction seen on the signal day.
